subject: Money
title: Silicon Valley Bank Collapse
description: One-minute skill: Silicon Valley Bank Collapse.

hook.text: In March 2023, Silicon Valley Bank collapsed in 48 hours. A tweet and a group chat triggered a digital bank run.

buildup.text: SVB held long-term bonds that lost value when rates rose. Depositors noticed and started withdrawing.

discovery.text: $42 billion was withdrawn in 24 hours. No lines at branches—just apps transferring millions per second.

twist.text: Social media accelerated the panic. By the time regulators responded, the bank was already dead.

climax.text: SVB proved bank runs are faster in the digital age. A 48-hour collapse would have taken weeks in the 1930s.

punchline.text: Modern bank runs happen at the speed of a tweet.

quiz.question: How much was withdrawn from SVB in 24 hours?
